description: This file implements the WarningReportingUnit class, which manages warning reporting categories, their configurations, and event reporting within the WPEFramework. It includes methods for singleton access, category management, configuration defaults, and warning event reporting.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Singleton class managing warning categories, configurations, and reporting within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::WarningReportingUnit
methods.description: Constructor initializing category map and lock, and registering the instance with the proxy.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::~WarningReportingUnit
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up categories and unregistering the instance.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::GetCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of category names currently managed.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the internal list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the internal list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Defaults
methods.description: Returns the current enabled categories as a JSON string.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::Defaults(const string&)
methods.description: Sets the default categories from a JSON string, parsing and updating internal state.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::UpdateEnabledCategories
methods.description: Updates internal enabled categories and configures existing category controls accordingly.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific category, including whether it is default, enabled, and its configuration.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit::ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event by creating a message and pushing it to the message queue.
